entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2.  The instant writ petition has been preferred for a direction to respondents to provide the compensation of the acquired land, which was utilized by the respondents under relevant provisions of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 in respect of petitioner's land acquired by respondent authority.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned Standing Counsel submits that the dispute falls within the jurisdiction of the District Level Committee constituted by the Government Order dated 12.5.2016 and as such no interference is required by this Court in the instant matter at this stage.
Jai Pal Singh vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13147320/

entities.text: Jai Pal Singh vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the issue involved, with the consent of parties herein, the writ petition stands disposed of with observation that in case the petitioner moves a fresh representation ventilating his grievances before the authority concerned constituted under the Government Order dated 12.05.2016 within two weeks, the same shall be considered and decided in accordance with law expeditiously, preferably within twelve weeks, thereafter.
Order Date :- 10.7.2025/NLY  Jai Pal Singh vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13147320/
